annotations.title: Life insurance in Poland: average premium per policy (KNF)

description: Use for the average price of life insurance in Poland (individual policy a year and group insurance per person), its trend, the insurance groups and the size of the market. Tell the user that this is a market average and not a price offer for one person. Average life insurance premium in Poland from the quarterly KNF bulletin "Rynek ubezpieczeń" (part D, class I of domestic life insurers): average annual gross written premium per individual contract over the last 4 quarters for the class I total and groups 1-5 (1 life, 2 marriage and birth assurance, 3 unit-linked, 4 annuity, 5 accident and sickness supplementary to life cover), change vs a year earlier, group premium per person covered by group insurance (for example insurance at work), individual and group contracts in force, insured persons, single-premium share, claims and benefits paid per 100 PLN of premium, quarterly history and the finwire index finwire_life_avg_premium. Amounts in PLN. These are market averages: they are not a price quote for a specific person. Informational data, not insurance advice.

history.description: Number of past quarters in the summary, default 8.
